item.title: Es-node
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Nasska
  • 発売日: 2010-08-13
  • スコア: なし (2 人評価)
  • 日本語名: Es-node
  • 英語名: 无

あらすじ

Play as a lone wanderer who lost his family in a fire.

Set in modern day Japan during times of great change,

the characters also have no choice but to forge ahead.

Together with your personal heroines, journey into the future.

Presenting the first work from energetic new collaborative Nasska.

“es-node”, an adventure game built on the Ren’py novel engine.
